newsitem.title: FINLAND: ASKO SELLS FORSSAN SAHA TO VAPO TIMBER.
newsitem.headline: ASKO SELLS FORSSAN SAHA TO VAPO TIMBER.

text.p: Finnish plastic pipes, white goods and furniture maker Asko Oy said on Monday it had sold its Forssan Saha sawmill unit to state-owned Vapo Timber Oy for an undisclosed sum.
"The sale of Forssan Saha is part of the strategy by which the Asko group is concentrating on its core business activities," Asko said in a statement.
Asko said the deal comprised Forssan Saha's business operations, fixed assets and inventories.
In 1996, Forssan Saha had net sales of 42 million markka and 46 employees, Asko said.
Vapo Timber, a subsidiary of state-owned peat and energy group Vapo Oy, intends to develop the sawmill's operations, Asko said.
The acquisition will raise Vapo Timber's sawing capacity to over 600,000 cubic metres per year, it said.
